title: Exporting model summaries and arrays
description: You can distinguish a JSON summary from a NumPy archive of model data.

steps.description: You create an artifact directory and collect selected model values in art. Scalars become float or int values, and array values become lists for JSON.
The with block writes art into summary.json. indent=2 formats the serialized object for reading.

steps.question: Does the NPZ call save only the values already placed in art?
steps.answer: No. It also names datasets, scaling values, component arrays and scores as archive entries.

steps.description: You finish by listing artifacts. The supplied output names density_feature_models.npz and summary.json.
